# EO:595: Order of the President, Mar. 18, 1907, amending order relative to allowances for Lieut. Col. Geo. W. Goethals, United States Army, as member of the commission 101 (contents entry 64)
# Source: Executive Orders Relating to the Isthmian Canal Commission, March, 1904, to June 12, 1911, inclusive (Washington: Government Printing Office, 1911); University of Florida copy (gift of the Panama Canal Museum); HathiTrust handle 2027/ufl1.ark:/13960/t3dz15k02
# PDF: releases/source_books/Isthmian_Canal_Commission_Executive_Orders_1904-1911_ufl1.ark+=13960=t3dz15k02.pdf sha256 4151116ad1c3ae8b08a9216f8591ca14e0d71ef20805c9250405d88aa6365eda
# PDF pages 114-114; printed pages 101-101; date 1907-03-18 (contents); body date check white_house_strict; confidence high
# Identity: EO number from the committed crosswalk (the volume prints none): EO:595
# Text: OCR text layer of the scan (pypdf 6.20.1 extract_text(), one JSON line per PDF page, NUL characters removed; the layer is the scan's own OCR), running heads and GPO footers removed. Not human-verified. Body sha256 84e6179b3da29485a6b225b66971e40f8f8bb1390f2cf6644897091d1aa45fce

The Order of March 4th is hereby amended so as to provide for
Lieutenant-Colonel George W. Goethals, U. S. A., the use of a fur-
nished dwelling house on the Isthmus of Panama, and he will be
allowed and paid liis actual and necessary expenses while away from
the Isthmus on official business.
Theodore Roosevelt.
The White House, March 18, 1907.

# Source: Executive Orders Relating to the Isthmian Canal Commission, March, 1904, to June 12, 1911, inclusive (Washington: Government Printing Office, 1911); University of Florida copy (gift of the Panama Canal Museum); HathiTrust handle 2027/ufl1.ark:/13960/t3dz15k02

# Text: OCR text layer of the scan (pypdf 6.20.1 extract_text(), one JSON line per PDF page, NUL characters removed; the layer is the scan's own OCR), running heads and GPO footers removed. Not human-verified. Body sha256 865423395f03fdc977f4e54b5c2b2cf610da569b7b32ef205286e1303f3f94b6

Lieutenant-Colonel George W. Goethals, U. S. A., is hereby ap-
pointed Chairman of the Isthmian Canal Commission effective this
date, vice John F. Stevens, resigned.
Chairman Goethals will receive the same compensation that was
fixed in the Executive Order of March 4, 1907, appointing him a
member of the Isthmian Canal Commission.
Theodore Roosevelt.
The White House, April 1, 1907.

Signed by President Theodore Roosevelt Monday, March 4, 1907

1907 CSR 116

625533Executive Order 577 — Authorizing Reinstatement of Lillie L. Wright as Clerk in Patent Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules1907President of the United States

Mrs. Lillie L. Wright, formerly a clerk in the Patent Office, may be reinstated without regard to the length of time she has been separated from the service.

Theodore Roosevelt.

The White House,

March 4, 1907.
